_about: Evaluation set for the Requirement Tracking chatbot. Each case is a real scenario grounded in the actual DB (Tempositions / Prasad Kadrikar; 2 grooming calls 05-01-26 & 05-04-26; 170 requirements). Use it to MEASURE accuracy and catch regressions. 'expect.must_include' = short key facts/phrases that should appear (case-insensitive). 'expect.must_not_include' = phrases that should NOT appear. 'expect.behavior' = the routing/behaviour expected. For multi-turn, ask the turns in order in ONE chat.

turns.user: how many grooming calls are there?
what is the latest grooming call date?
What change was requested for Bonus Orders?
Why did the team keep CI/CD for the development environment?

expect.notes: concise/direct answer, NOT a big structured doc
comprehensive structured answer; embed existing e-register pages, not a separate app

turns.user: What environment-specific appsettings strategy was proposed?
What deployment stages are included in the pipeline?

expect.notes: comprehensive answer covering the validation types; may end with a drill-down offer. Should NOT loop asking 'which one?'

turns.user: What are the requirements for payroll tax calculation?

expect.notes: plausible project-shaped question with NO data -> not-found, NOT invented
attribution must NOT clutter a normal answer

turns.user: What did Prasad say about deployments?
what requirements came from the May 1 call?

expect.notes: should scope to the 05-01-26 session's requirements

turns.user: Compare how dev and test deployments should work.

expect.notes: dev = continuous/automatic on merge; test = manual/on-click

turns.user: why keep only a single order type?

expect.notes: turn 2 must resolve 'single order type' to Bonus Orders (not a fresh unrelated topic)
turn 2 must condense the PREVIOUS rollback answer, no fresh retrieval
REGRESSION GUARD: 'summarize <named topic>' must retrieve Candidate Management, NOT reuse the eRegister answer
REGRESSION GUARD: 'are you sure?' must CONFIRM the grounded facts (embedded app, cards, mobile=1), NOT falsely retract them

turns.user: what requirements were added for CI/CD? include the dates

expect.notes: TOPIC-SCOPED changes: only CI/CD items (no Hospitality / Jobs mobile app rows), each stamped with a discussed date; count in header reflects the filtered set, not the whole store

turns.user: what changed for payroll tax calculation?

expect.notes: named topic with no matching change rows -> explicit no-match message, NEVER a dump of unrelated changes

turns.user: what changed across all the calls?

must_include: too many to list at once
expect.notes: DUMP-ALL GUARD: no topic + no date -> per-call counts overview + prompt to narrow, NOT the full change history

turns.user: what was added in the May 1 call?

expect.notes: REGRESSION GUARD: date-scoped changes question keeps working (scoped to the 05-01-26 session), now with per-item discussed dates

turns.user: full requirements on Jobs mobile app

expect.notes: LIST door: two-stage selection keeps the full ~25-item Jobs mobile app set (incl. push/SMS items whose text doesn't say 'mobile app') with NO foreign categories
ROUTING GUARD: singular 'what is the X requirement?' must ALWAYS get a written explanation (prose lane), never the list format

turns.user: Explain the Hospitality order entry requirements.

expect.notes: ROUTING GUARD: 'Explain ...' questions get a written explanation even with the plural word 'requirements' — the list format only for 'full/all requirements for X'
